title: Sweet Almond Bliss Bites
description: Vegan sweet treats made with almond flour and blissful ingredients.
instructions: In a food processor, grind the dates into a paste.
In a large bowl, combine the almond flour, coconut sugar, and vanilla extract.
Add the date paste to the dry ingredients and mix until well combined.
Add the almond milk and mix until a dough forms.
Roll the dough into small balls and place on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 15-20 minutes or until lightly golden brown.
